messages.subject: sim.fn() function not working
parts:
Hello,

I keep getting an error when trying to run sim.fn()

"Error: could not find function "sim.fn""


I have successfully installed both R and thee packag "unmarked".

the code: 

```R
> loadedlibs  = library("unmarked")
> require("unmarked")
Loading required package: unmarked
Loading required package: reshape
Loading required package: lattice
Loading required package: Rcpp

> tmp <- sim.fn( quad.size = 10, cell.size = 1, intensity = 1)
Error: could not find function "sim.fn"

> loadedlibs
 [1] "unmarked"  "Rcpp"      "lattice"   "reshape"   "stats"     "graphics" 
 [7] "grDevices" "utils"     "datasets"  "methods"   "base" 
```
The package "unmarked" is clearly loaded, so am I missing something?

Thanks in advance.

parts:
Hi Kyle,

have you downloaded the latest version of the AHMbook package ? Here is what the book web site says.

Hope that helps, best regards  -- Marc


Install the AHMbook R package

To install the AHMbook package, you need R version 3.3.0 or later. AHMbook depends on several other packages and you must install (or update) these first. To do that run: 

install.packages(c("unmarked", "plotrix", "sp", "raster", "RandomFields", "coda"))

Once they - and all the packages they depend on - are installed, you can download and install AHMbook with 

install.packages("AHMbook", repos = "http://mikemeredith.net/R")

If that command doesn’t work, go to http://mikemeredith.net/R to download the file needed for manual installation.
